title: 第26章 隐雾之牙第27章 地脉生物惊现
slug: 法师之上第366章五环法师
content_zh:
热闹的摊位瞬间冷清下来。
年轻摊主似乎也有些受打击，垂头丧气了许久，才重新抬起头来，猛地发现自己的摊位前竟然还站着一个人。
一个年纪不大，穿着朴素的少年。
年轻摊主的记性还行，微微一愣，便是认出高德是刚刚那一批看热闹人中的一个。
“没有热闹可看了，你还不走？”年轻摊主撇嘴道，倒是没有给高德摆脸色。
高德冲年轻摊主笑了笑，开口道：
“我可不是来看热闹的。”
“嗯？”
高德伸手指了指刚刚引起争吵的那件铜制物，诚恳道：“4枚西恩金币，卖吗？”
高德真的很诚恳。
因为他的全部身家也就是4金15银。
年轻摊主沉吟了片刻，并没有立刻回复，而是盯着高德还带着些许稚气的脸庞问道：
“你不认为我是在骗你？”
“虽然符文纹路已经磨损，但还是能看出完整的符文应该相当了不得。”高德又仔细看了好几眼那件铜制物，确定道。
年轻摊主沉默了片刻，最后拿起那件铜制物，递给高德，“成交。”
高德也不拖拉，干脆利落地从口袋中拿出三枚西恩金币以及二十枚三叶花银币递给年轻摊主。
看着手上零零整整的金币与银币，年轻摊主犹豫了一下，叹了口气，又开口道：
“实话与你说吧，这件铜制物名为隐雾之牙，完整无损的时候可是一环魔法炼金造物，可以释放一环法术隐雾术，只是在一次战斗中法术符文意外磨损了。”
“所以我刚才说的若是将之修复好，转手卖个六七十枚西恩金币不是问题这句话确实不是吹牛。”
1环超凡物品的平均价格一般就是65枚金币。

高德没有表现得太过激动，因为摊主都这么说了，必然还有后续。
果不其然。
“只是......我父亲曾经找过附魔修理师，检查过后，那个附魔修理师发现这根隐雾之牙法术符文磨损的地方正是核心符文。”
“想要将之修复好，几乎等于是要重新隽刻一遍法术符文，超出他的能力范围，此事也就不了了之。”
“所以，想要将之修复，不是件简单的事。”
“我看你手头也不宽裕，若是反悔，这笔交易就算了吧。”
年轻摊主神情有些无奈，又有些懊恼。
“没事，若是实在找不到修复的方法，我留着当收藏也行。”高德平和的声音响起。
年轻摊主一怔，还没反应过来。
这边高德得了心怡的物品，再加上囊中羞涩，也无心继续闲逛，已经是信步离去。
......
药园。
棕黑色的房门前。
刚从城镇广场回来的高德轻敲房门。
“咳......进来。”门内传来塞达法师夹杂着咳嗽声的熟悉声音。
高德连忙推开房门。
塞达法师坐在原木长桌前，正对着他。
一见到塞达法师，高德心中一惊。
也就十几日不见，塞达法师的状态却仿佛是生了一场大病，面色病恹恹到了极点。
原先的塞达法师虽然气色灰败，但也不至于像现在这般，面容中几乎看不见半点血色，和死尸一般的惨白。

高德按捺住心中的疑问与蠢蠢欲动，赶紧上前给塞达法师行了一礼，然后恭敬至极地双手递上菲尔魔药店的收货单，头深深埋低。
content_en:
The busy stalls suddenly became deserted.
The young stall owner seemed to be a little bit shocked. He was downcast for a long time before he raised his head again and suddenly found that there was still a person standing in front of his stall.
A young man who is not very old and dressed simply.
The young stall owner's memory was not bad, and he was slightly startled when he recognized Gao De as one of the group of spectators just now.
"There's no excitement to see, why don't you leave?" the young stall owner curled his lips, but did not show off to Gothe.
Gao De smiled at the young stall owner and said:
"I'm not here to watch the fun."
"Huh?"
Gothe pointed at the copper object that had just caused the quarrel, and said sincerely: "4 Xian gold coins, do you want to sell them?"
Gaode is really sincere.
Because his entire net worth is 4 gold medals and 15 silver medals.
The young stall owner pondered for a moment and did not reply immediately. Instead, he stared at Gothe's childish face and asked:
"You don't think I'm lying to you?"
"Although the rune patterns have been worn away, it can still be seen that the complete runes should be quite impressive." Gothe took a closer look at the copper object several times and confirmed.
The young stall owner was silent for a moment, and finally picked up the copper object and handed it to Gothe, "Deal."
Gothe didn't delay, and neatly took out three Sean gold coins and twenty silver clover coins from his pocket and handed them to the young stall owner.
Looking at the scattered gold and silver coins in his hand, the young stall owner hesitated for a moment, sighed, and said again:
"To tell you the truth, this copper object is called the Fang of the Hidden Mist. When it was intact, it was a magic alchemy creation that could release the Hidden Mist spell. However, the spell runes were accidentally worn out during a battle."
"So what I just said is not bragging if I repair it and resell it for sixty or seventy Xion gold coins."
The average price of a level 1 extraordinary item is generally 65 gold coins.
Gaode didn't show too much excitement, because the stall owner said so, and there must be a follow-up.
Sure enough.
"It's just...my father once found an enchantment repairman. After inspection, the enchantment repairman discovered that the wear and tear of the Hidden Mist Fang spell rune was exactly the core rune."
"To repair it is almost equivalent to carving the spell runes all over again, which is beyond his ability, so the matter will be left alone."
"So, it's not an easy task to repair it."
"I see that you don't have much money. If you regret it, forget about this deal."
The young stall owner looked a little helpless and a little annoyed.
"It's okay. If I really can't find a way to repair it, I can just keep it for collection." Gao De's peaceful voice sounded.
The young stall owner was startled and had not yet reacted.
Goude got something he liked here, and since he was short of money, he had no intention of continuing to wander around, so he walked away.
...
Medicine garden.
In front of the brown-black door.
Gothe, who had just returned from the town square, knocked on the door.
"Ahem...come in." The familiar voice of Master Seda mixed with coughing came from the door.
Gothe quickly opened the door.
Master Seda sat at the long wooden table, facing him.
When he saw Master Seda, Gao De was shocked.
We haven't seen him for more than ten days, but Master Seda seems to be in a serious illness, and his face is extremely sick.
Although the original Master Seda looked ashen, he was not as pale as he is now. There was almost no trace of blood in his face, and he was as pale as a corpse.
Gothe suppressed the doubts and impatience in his heart, and quickly stepped forward to salute Master Seda, and then handed over the receipt of Phil's Potion Store's receipt with extremely respectful hands, his head bowed deeply.
